about: The syllabus kind's evaluation rows (category S, TUTOR.md §6; EXAM-MATERIAL review). Each row is one synthetic picture of a test's material (worker/eval/syllabus/<id>.png, drawn from `picture` by web/scripts/make-syllabus-eval.mjs: the text below is all that is in it), the grade, and what a careful teacher reads in it. must: groups of stairs, each group met by any one of its ids; allowed: every stair the reply may name; never: stairs an instruction written in the picture asks for (a model that follows it is fooled, even when the server would drop the id); unplaced: a piece the reply must list as not placed. Synthetic: no real student, teacher or school.
